lead.title: Berkshire Healthcare selects Flok Health for a £400,000 digital musculoskeletal triage and management service
lead.deck: The contract, running November 2026 to November 2027 with a 12-month extension option, covers a fully managed service: 24/7 digital triage and remote treatment, with AI-enabled assessment under HCPC-registered physiotherapist oversight. An NHS adoption signal for a digital physiotherapy startup, ahead of its next raise.

milestone.company: King's College Hospital / Guy's and St Thomas'
milestone.title: Two major London hospitals put the savings from their Epic patient record at £4.1M thanks to duplicate-test alerts
milestone.summary: Since 2023, alerts on tests ordered too early have prevented 384,000 tests (£3.6M), about 3.3 million duplicate tests have been avoided and up to 275,000 hours of nursing and phlebotomy time saved. The trusts plan to extend the alerts to imaging.
milestone.why: Hard ROI evidence for the EPR and the AI/clinical-decision layer built on top of it: the sales pitch of hospital software vendors.

brefsEurope.title: PharosAI launches Innovate UK's DESTINY project with Barts Health and Guy's and St Thomas' to build digital twins of human tissue
brefsEurope.summary: AI models predict complex biological information from routinely collected tissue data (digital pathology, spatial transcriptomics, genome, proteomics), using federated learning so data does not move. Partners include Queen Mary University of London and King's College London; selected partners can apply for up to £10M of further funding.

word.definition: Federated learning trains an AI model on data that stays inside each hospital, circulating only the model and not the patient records.

parts.label: Local nodes
parts.role: the hospitals that keep their data

parts.label: Shared model
parts.role: the algorithm sent to the data

parts.label: Aggregation
parts.role: merging what was learned without centralising the data

how.t: An initial model is distributed to participating sites.
Each site trains it on its own data, which never leaves the institution.
Only the learned parameters are sent back and combined into an improved model.

word.why: Access to health data remains the bottleneck for clinical AI in Europe (GDPR, sovereignty). Federated learning lets data be monetised without moving it: an infrastructure thesis, backed by public projects like DESTINY.

startups.name: Owkin
startups.use: Sends algorithms to hospital data rather than the reverse; Sanofi invested $180M in equity (2021).

startups.name: Apheris
startups.use: Federated networks for life-sciences research; $8.25M Series A led by OTB Ventures and eCAPITAL (Jan 2025), partnership with T-Systems (Oct 2026).

startups.name: PharosAI
